knowledge_gaps: The scoring interface is underspecified: predict_score(features, items) receives no sequence, so the residual must already be incorporated into features or passed through an explicitly adapted interface. Training, diagnosis, and generated inference must use identical prefix masking, embedding scaling, normalization, and final-position selection.

Training-only pseudo-holdouts may contain targets already used to fit the model. Their results measure in-sample reliance unless targets are excluded from fitting; they cannot establish generalization. Deletion probes also need explicit rules for position shifts and recency-weight recomputation.

The report lacks controls separating recency weighting from additional embedding gradients, pooling, and score scaling. A positive sigmoid gate cannot exactly recover the baseline at finite parameter values, and interaction-step decay does not establish sensitivity to elapsed time.

Reproduction details remain missing: efficient prefix pooling, diagnostic sample sizes, candidate construction, checkpoint selection, and allocation of the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. The difficulty score of 3 understates the complete adapter and evaluation work.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve the implementation contract and computational cost before treating the change as straightforward.
follow_up_queries.query: How can SASRec incorporate a learned exponentially weighted item-embedding residual into every causal prefix representation using an O(BLd) recurrence, with left-padding masks, parameter-free layer normalization, and consistent embedding scaling? Describe how the same fused features support positive/negative training scores, a predict_score(features, items) diagnostic interface, and final-position inference, including numerical parity checks.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make perturbation findings interpretable and distinguish training-sample reliance from predictive generalization.
follow_up_queries.query: What experimental protocols support reliable history-perturbation diagnostics for sequential recommenders when pseudo-holdout targets were already present during model fitting? Discuss recent-versus-old deletion, position-preserving masking versus sequence compaction, last-item-preserving shuffling, fixed candidate sets, user-level paired uncertainty, and which conclusions require genuinely excluded targets.

follow_up_queries.reason: Test whether the proposed mechanism adds value beyond simpler alternatives and limit validation-driven overfitting.
follow_up_queries.query: Which controlled ablations distinguish benefits of a learned recency residual in SASRec from mean pooling, last-item scoring, changed logit scale, and extra gradients into shared item embeddings? Consider an exactly disabled residual, fixed versus learned gates, interaction-step versus timestamp decay, and a bounded experiment plan selected by fixed 99-negative macro validation HR@10 across four Amazon datasets.
